func TestInitExternalLogMultipleBackends(t *testing.T) {
	logger, err := initExternalLog(services.AuditConfig{
		AuditEventsURI: []string{"file://" + t.TempDir(), "stdout://"},
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer logger.Close()

	emitter, ok := logger.(events.Emitter)
	require.True(t, ok)
	event := &events.SessionStart{}
	event.SetType(events.SessionStartEvent)
	require.NoError(t, emitter.EmitAuditEvent(context.Background(), event))
}
